body:
Founder ran the real Colab script and hit a real failure: 'make emily-bot' failed with 'go: not found' -- Colab's base image has no Go. Added _ensure_go() installing the official Go 1.23.4 tarball, idempotent (skips if go already satisfies go.mod's floor). Commit SHANKPIT@0a392fa.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-50 follow-up: fixed colab_train.py missing Go toolchain (real live Colab failure)
